review.posthog_relevance: HogFlow editor workflow visualization and node description management
review.reason: Adds zoom-dependent display behavior and state tracking to the HogFlow editor, allowing workflows to zoom out further and conditionally hide detailed node descriptions when zoomed out. This improves the usability and clarity of workflow visualization in the HogFlow editor.

observations.behavior: Adds zoom-dependent display behavior to HogFlow editor.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows HogFlow workflows to zoom out further than React Flow's default, and switches the node description display to a simplified, less detailed representation when zoomed out beyond a threshold.

observations.behavior: Adds a new state and action to track whether the workflow is zoomed out far, and uses this state to conditionally hide detailed node descriptions.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the HogFlow editor to track and respond to the zoom state, enabling the conditional hiding of detailed node descriptions when zoomed out far.
